mostWorthwhile.text: Building the muscle pulling proteins was most worthwhile: the picture showed overlapping fibres sliding to shorten a cell, connecting the instructions to a job.

leastWorthwhile.text: The support-cell sequence felt somewhat repetitive after the muscle sequence, although it showed a different result.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that cells with the same DNA can make different proteins, and that supporting cells release protein into the material around them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the messenger pictures named the genes they affected, and amino acids were identified as protein building blocks. How the messengers cause particular genes to become active was not explained in detail.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing how cells with different jobs become larger tissues sounds interesting, especially after the muscle-cell picture mentioned a later muscle chapter.
